title: A texture cache
description:
Share loaded resources with `shared_ptr` and forget them with `weak_ptr`.

```
load "grass": loaded
load "grass": from cache (2 users)
both users gone -> "grass" freed
load "grass": loaded again
```
hints: `if (auto live{m_items[name].lock()}) return live;` (lesson 5.03). `m_items[name]` looks the name up in the `std::unordered_map`, creating an empty `weak_ptr` entry if it is new; assigning a `shared_ptr` to it, `m_items[name] = texture;`, remembers the texture without owning it.
A `weak_ptr` does not keep the texture alive, so the cache never stops it being freed.
requirements: `get(name)` returns the live `shared_ptr` if `lock()` works, or loads a new one.
Print when a texture is created and destroyed.
stretch: Remove expired entries from the map now and then.
